raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Part of #6483. Same precomputed-embedding early-return as InternVL (#19127), MiniCPM (#19614), Janus-Pro (#24377): when `items[0].format == MultimodalInputFormat.PRECOMPUTED_EMBEDDING`, flatten per-item features to 2D and concatenate. Skips the vision tower for callers that already have the embedding (RL workflows, KV cache reuse, disaggregated serving).

Pixtral checkpoints split across two sglang model classes by HF arch, `mistralai/Mistral-Small-4` and `Mistral-Small-3.1` declare `PixtralForConditionalGeneration`, while `mistral-community/pixtral-12b` declares `LlavaForConditionalGeneration` (sglang's Llava class is the documented adapter for it). Both get the early-return.

`processors/pixtral.py` also needed a small fix: its custom resize loop iterates `mm_data.images` and calls `img.size`, which crashed on dict items that `processor_output` / `precomputed_embedding` requests carry. Filter dicts before the loop; `process_and_combine_mm_data` handles them on its own path.

## Verification

End-to-end on H100 (sglang 0.5.10.post1 / torch 2.9.1.7+cu129 / CUDA 12.9), `mistral-community/pixtral-12b` loaded from local NFS:

```
test_accepts_image (TestPixtralUnderstandsImage.test_accepts_image) ... ok
test_accepts_precomputed_embeddings (TestPixtralUnderstandsImage.test_accepts_precomputed_embeddings) ... ok
test_accepts_processor_output (TestPixtralUnderstandsImage.test_accepts_processor_output) ... ok
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Ran 3 tests in 120.783s

OK
```

Pre-commit + ruff: clean.

@@ -6,12 +6,17 @@
 import torch
 from PIL import Image
 
+from sglang.srt.managers.mm_schedule import _get_precomputed_embedding
 from sglang.srt.managers.mm_utils import get_new_expanded_mm_items
 from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_batch import (
     Modality,
     MultimodalDataItem,
     MultimodalInputFormat,
 )
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.base_processor import (
+    BaseMultiModalProcessorOutput,
+    MultimodalSpecialTokens,
+)
 from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.pixtral import PixtralProcessor
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
@@ -112,6 +117,36 @@ def test_mismatched_patch_rows_fail_loudly(self):
         with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "patch rows"):
             processor._finalize_mm_items([item], images=images)
 
+    def test_precomputed_embedding_reaches_pixtral_scheduler(self) -> None:
+        processor = self._make_processor()
+        processor._processor = MagicMock()
+        processor._tokenizer = MagicMock()
+        embedding = torch.arange(8, dtype=torch.float32).reshape(2, 4)
+
+        items, _, _ = processor.process_and_combine_mm_data(
+            base_output=BaseMultiModalProcessorOutput(
+                input_text="",
+                input_ids=[7, 7],
+                images=[
+                    {
+                        "feature": embedding,
+                        "format": "precomputed_embedding",
+                    }
+                ],
+            ),
+            mm_tokens=MultimodalSpecialTokens(image_token_id=7),
+        )
+        result = _get_precomputed_embedding(
+            items=items,
+            items_size=[0, 1],
+            prefix_length=[0],
+            extend_length=[2],
+            items_offset_list=[[(0, 1)]],
+        )
+
+        self.assertIsNotNone(result)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(result, embedding, rtol=0, atol=0)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
